messages:
sam: Hey team — tried pulling zeta-2 weights from HF origin and got a 403, mirror job reported success though. Anyone seen origin auth flakes recently?

marta: I can repro locally, HF returned an HTML 403 page. Shadow-sync role token looks expired for that run.

ben: Note: our mirror pipeline marks artifact as mirrored once the S3 put succeeds. We don't currently re-validate origin checksum after transfer, so a bad origin or partial transfer can slip by.

zane: We should add a post-mirror checksum validation step. Compute sha256 on the S3 object and compare to manifest.digest. I have a tiny patch idea.

sam: Agreed. Also need a serving fallback if mirror becomes suspect. Can we route traffic to hosted cache or a compatible variant while we re-mirror? Dedicated customers will hit this.

marta: We have routing fallbacks for capacity, not for integrity. Proposal: if checksum mismatch -> mark mirror as stale, trigger re-mirror + route to compatible model variant (e.g., zeta-2-lite) until re-mirror completes.

ben: Quick technical: our manifest currently has "digest" (sha256) already, but no place for origin-etag or presign headers. I'll add origin-etag and a checksum_verified boolean. Also add a test that verifies content-length and sha256.

zane: Also seeing tokenizer quirks: HF tokenizer.json for this model is BPE but missing the "tokenizer.name" field we require. That causes tokenization drift (off-by-one) in evals. Registry-checker should validate tokenizer presence + name match.

ben: Good catch. I'll include tokenizer validation in the same registry-checker change.

infra-bot: build 2026.03.16/881 - s3 upload verification step failed for job zeta-2-mirror-2026-03-16-17:41 (checksum mismatch).

sam: I'm going to requeue a re-mirror with larger chunk size and extended presign TTL. Command I'll run: 
```
./tools/mirror.sh --model zeta-2 --chunk-size 64m --presign-ttl 1200
```
Please watch logs. @marta can you confirm shadow-sync role rotation finished?

marta: Rotation in progress, ETA ~10m. Also please make mirror logs include origin response headers (content-length, etag) so we can diff against S3 object metadata.

ben: Will add origin headers to mirror logs and include an explicit post-mirror sha256 check. Also adding a small retry loop for transient 403 from HF (3 retries with exponential backoff). PR incoming: #472.

zane: Opened PR #473 for tokenizer validation on registry-checker with unit tests. Adds check for tokenizer.json presence and consistent tokenizer.name.

sam: Action items: ben -> post-mirror checksum + logs PR; zane -> tokenizer validation PR; marta -> confirm creds rotation and re-run shadow-sync; sam -> trigger re-mirror and monitor. Ping here when re-mirror finishes. :thumbsup:
